_doc: Backing services: how a datastore/tool seen in a repo maps to a Clever Cloud add-on. Zone availability is NEVER taken from here: plan.py reads it live (clever addon providers show <id> --format json) and falls back to rules/_zones.json only when the CLI cannot answer, saying so. 'two_org' = the boundary shown when a component runs in the second, non-HDS organisation (zone par): when the plan targets HDS, plan.py places there every service absent from parhds or marked 'hds': 'not_recommended' (the default recommendation, decision of 2026-10-26), --two-org overrides it. 'hds': 'not_recommended' + 'hds_reason' = possible in HDS but never recommended there. 'default_plan' of PostgreSQL and MySQL is used only when the catalogue cannot be read: a plan that holds the assumed 1 GB x2 (never the smallest plan by default); otherwise sizing.pick_db_plan() chooses from the live catalogue.

postgresql.default_plan_note: xxs_med: max DB size 2 GB, 512 MB RAM, 45 connections (catalogue read 2026-10-25), the assumed 1 GB x2; never xxs_tny (512 MB) by default
postgresql.conventions_doc: a variable the app reads (left) and the Clever add-on variable it should fall back to (right): Clever does not inject the left one, and its variables cannot reference each other
postgresql.label: PostgreSQL add-on

wiring.dotnet:Npgsql: Npgsql takes a key=value string, not a URI: Host=POSTGRESQL_ADDON_HOST;Port=POSTGRESQL_ADDON_PORT;Database=POSTGRESQL_ADDON_DB;Username=POSTGRESQL_ADDON_USER;Password=POSTGRESQL_ADDON_PASSWORD

mysql.default_plan_note: xxs_big: max DB size 2 GB, 512 MB RAM, 15 connections (catalogue read 2026-10-25), the assumed 1 GB x2; never xxs_sml (512 MB) by default
mysql.conventions_doc: a variable the app reads (left) and the Clever add-on variable it should fall back to (right): Clever does not inject the left one, and its variables cannot reference each other
mysql.label: MySQL add-on

redis.env_hint: REDIS_HOST, REDIS_PORT, REDIS_PASSWORD, REDIS_URL (observed 2026-10-25; the add-on requires the password)
redis.conventions_doc: a variable the app reads (left) and the Clever add-on variable it should fall back to (right): Clever does not inject the left one, and its variables cannot reference each other

wiring.dotnet:StackExchange.Redis: StackExchange.Redis takes no redis:// URL: ConfigurationOptions with EndPoints = REDIS_HOST:REDIS_PORT and Password = REDIS_PASSWORD
wiring.python: redis-py: Redis(host=REDIS_HOST, port=int(REDIS_PORT), password=REDIS_PASSWORD) or Redis.from_url(REDIS_URL)
wiring.node: ioredis / node-redis: new Redis(process.env.REDIS_URL) / createClient({ url: process.env.REDIS_URL })
